## Summary
- Describe what changed and why.
- Link related issue(s) or ticket(s).

## Validation
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e:ci` (or explain why not run)

## Core Regression Checklist
- [ ] Auth flow works (sign in, sign out, protected routes)
- [ ] Group flow works (create, open, settings access)
- [ ] Expense flow works (add, edit, delete)
- [ ] Settlement flow works (suggested payment, record settlement, remove settlement)
- [ ] Profile flow works (read and update profile)

## Risk Notes
- List edge cases, migrations, or follow-up tasks.
